name: aggrega-vscode-extension
description: Language support for Aggrega YAML — validation, navigation, hover, completion via the aggrega daemon.

aggrega.server.binaryPath.description: Path to the aggrega binary. Plain name resolves via PATH; absolute or relative paths are honored as written.

aggrega.server.autoRevalidate.description: When true, silently revalidates a file on cache-miss and retries the request. When false, surfaces a notification with a Revalidate action.

aggrega.server.debounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for proactive validate-on-change.

aggrega.server.respawnAttempts.description: Maximum daemon respawn attempts within the sliding window before the extension surfaces a stopped-responding notification.

aggrega.server.respawnWindowSeconds.description: Sliding window in seconds for counting daemon respawn attempts.

aggrega.server.restartGraceSeconds.description: Grace window in seconds before the extension automatically restarts the daemon after a binaryPath change. The status bar surfaces a countdown during the window; the quick-action menu offers Restart now and Cancel restart.

aggrega.notifications.toastDebounceMode.description: How repeated toast notifications for the same error code are debounced. `time` re-surfaces after `toastThrottleSeconds` elapses since the last toast went away (action click, X click, or auto-dismiss). `session` suppresses repeats until the daemon restarts (the previous default).

aggrega.notifications.toastThrottleSecon.description: Throttle window in seconds between toast re-surfacings of the same error code. Consulted only when `toastDebounceMode` is `time`.

scripts.build-fixtures: mkdir -p out/test-fixtures && cd ../aggrega-cli && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o ../aggrega-vscode-extension/out/test-fixtures/aggrega ./cmd/aggrega
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run build-fixtures
